sentences.text: Robert Dale `` Rob '' McElhenney -LRB- born April 14 , 1977 -RRB- is an American actor , director , producer , and screenwriter .
He is best known for playing Mac on the FX/FXX comedy series It 's Always Sunny in Philadelphia .	Philadelphia	Philadelphia	Mac	Mac (It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia)	FX	FX Networks	FXX	FXX
He is also one of the developers , executive producers , and the creator of the show , which has provided him with writing and directing credits on various episodes .
